poison_arrow.name: Poison Arrow
poison_arrow.description: A green-stained arrow that leaves venom in the wound.
poison_arrow.telegraph: The goblin nocks a green-stained arrow.

bone_volley.name: Bone Volley
bone_volley.description: A clatter of sharpened bone shards.
bone_volley.telegraph: The skeleton rattles and raises a fistful of bone shards.

savage_bite.name: Savage Bite
savage_bite.description: A tearing bite that feeds the beast.
savage_bite.telegraph: The wolf lowers its head and snarls.

dark_bolt.name: Dark Bolt
dark_bolt.description: A lance of cold, whispered power.
dark_bolt.telegraph: The cultist's voice drops to a whisper.

spectral_touch.name: Spectral Touch
spectral_touch.description: A numbing touch from beyond the grave.
spectral_touch.telegraph: The specter's outline thins and reaches toward you.

shield_bash.name: Shield Bash
shield_bash.description: A crushing blow that leaves the sentinel braced.
shield_bash.telegraph: The Iron Sentinel locks its shield forward.

repair.name: Repair
repair.description: Runes knit the sentinel's plates back together.
repair.telegraph: The Iron Sentinel's runes flicker to life.

dirty_trick.name: Dirty Trick
dirty_trick.description: A pocketful of stinging powder and a low blow.
dirty_trick.telegraph: Vargas reaches into his coat with a thin smile.
